title: CALLED TO THE FEAST
author: J. E. Landor
stanzas: Called to the feast by the King are we, Sitting, perhaps, where his people be; How will it fare, friend, with thee and me When the King comes in?
Crowns on the head where the thorns have been, Glorified he who once died for men; Splendid the vision before us then, When the King comes in.
Like lightning's flash will that instant show Things hidden long from both friend and foe; Just what we are will each neighbor know, When the King comes in.â€ƒ
chorus: When the King comes in, brother, When the King comes in! How will it fare with thee and me When the King comes in?
